capability: bounded, operator-scored software improvement that may compound only on an isolated Airlock branch
changes: Adds airlock improve for repeated candidate search against one committed operator-owned objective.
Requires the Airlock config, objective, and repository evaluator files to be committed unchanged and protected before a run.
Measures each frozen base and candidate repeatedly; overlapping noisy ranges do not count as improvement.
Scores conservative measured gain minus an operator-authored changed-line complexity penalty.
Refuses ambiguous winners, weak gains, binary changes, protected changes, excessive files, excessive changed lines, and unmeasurable states.
Compounds accepted generations as normal commits on airlock/improve/<run-id> without moving the starting branch.
Writes signed, hash-chained generation receipts and verifies the complete base-to-final-commit chain without running candidate code.
Repositions the public README and Show HN draft around software that can earn its own improvements.
claim_boundary: The deterministic acceptance fixture proves ten-generation mechanics, isolation from the starting branch, and receipt-chain verification. It does not establish that an external coding agent can produce ten real improvements, that one local metric captures total product value, or that a local benchmark gain survives production. A live canary or deployment loop remains out of scope.
economics_boundary: Provider-reported spend is recorded and unknown spend remains unknown. It cannot influence promotion because it is not independently authenticated. Dollar ROI requires a later external billing receipt.
invariants: Agents may propose code but cannot change the operator objective, evaluator, Starter Rules, tests, workflows, or release key.
A candidate's worst observed metric must clear the base's best observed metric by the committed minimum gain.
Several ordinary survivors remain several; the improvement loop selects only when the protected scoring rule establishes one unique winner.
The starting branch is never checked out, reset, or advanced by the loop.
Execution or deployment authority remains outside airlock improve.
